column1: # LOG-PORTMAP.tsv - the declared reference -> port file mapping G-LOGFILE reconciles against.
# Read .port/tools/gates/check_log_reconcile.py first; this file is only data.
# oracle_file   the reference path, relative to the read-only ghostty checkout, at pin
#               20abdb50a. Every .zig file cited by a LOG-class LEDGER row MUST appear
#               here; a missing entry is itself a finding and turns the gate RED.
# port_arms     `|`-separated ARMS. Each arm is `+`-separated FILES.
#                 files inside one arm are SUMMED  - one reference file split across
#                 arms are compared INDEPENDENTLY and the file's score is the MINIMUM
#                   - arms are PLATFORM TWINS, only one of which is compiled on a given
#                   target. Summing them is exactly how finding N9 hid: a fully
#                   restored macOS twin covering a Linux twin that emitted almost none
#                   of it, with three rows reading as done.
# allowance     how many reference sites the port is PERMITTED to be short by. A RATCHET:
#               an allowance LARGER than the measured deficit is RED, so restoring a site
#               must tighten this number in the same commit. Never env-settable.
# bypass_cap    how many of this file's emissions are permitted to BYPASS the log facade
#               - raw `eprintln!("warn(scope): ...")` reproducing logFn's OUTPUT but not
#               its behaviour (it ignores Logging.stderr, never reaches macOS unified
#               logging, and has no level or scope to filter on). Finding N14. Its own
#               RATCHET, MAX over arms not min - a bypass on any platform arm is a bypass.
#               It exists because "restore the missing sites" and "stop bypassing the
#               facade" pull in opposite directions: without this cap a stage could close
#               a count deficit by adding MORE direct prints and the gate would read it
# reason        mandatory whenever allowance > 0 OR bypass_cap > 0, the same rule G-PARITY
#               applies to a WAIVED row's `owner`. One with no reason is RED.
# The mapping is DECLARED, not inferred. Filename guessing gets at least five of these
# renderer_seam.rs (a different crate), OpenGL.zig's head -> opengl/gl/sys.rs,
# main_ghostty.zig -> rustty-core/src/logging.rs, and both renderer platform-twin pairs.
# Baselined 2026-09-10 against oracle pin 20abdb50a (task 14gate; allowances corrected in
# fix round 1, bypass_cap added in fix round 2). The allowances are the measured deficit,
# frozen, tracked as NEW-FINDINGS.md N12; the bypass caps are the measured facade bypass,
# frozen, tracked as N14. Both are ratchets: a declared number LARGER than what is measured
# is RED, so an improvement must tighten it in the same commit.
